name: SIA 308 烟雾 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 308, a flight from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are parking at gate M5, you have got the latest ATIS G, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 308，从武汉飞往法兰克福，停在 M5 登机口，已收到最新 ATIS G，联系武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 308, gate M5, information G, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 308，M5 登机口，收到 G 情报，申请前往法兰克福的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1,500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 11,000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1,500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 11,000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 2000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 2000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 308, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 308，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, Wuhan Ground, taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to holding point E5 Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，武汉地面，经 Z4、A2、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 的 E5 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A two, A to holding point E five Runway 04, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A2、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 的 E5 等待点，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point E5, Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower, and tell controller you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 E5 等待点，跑道 04，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 308, holding point E5, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 308，E5 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, line up Runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，五边有航空器。
cards.referenceText: Roger, line up Runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and ask to cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场并请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 308, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, request cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 308，已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，武汉离场，雷达识别，取消 SID，右转直飞 ZF，爬升至并保持 4,500 米。
cards.referenceText: cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4,500 meters, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，右转直飞 ZF，爬升至并保持 4,500 米，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: Now you are en route in Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you are cruising at FL360, make initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在德国航路上飞行，处于莱茵雷达管制区，巡航高度为 FL360，与莱茵雷达管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA 308, en route, cruising at FL360.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，SIA 308，正在航路飞行，巡航高度 FL360。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，保持 FL360，因前方天气向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining FL360, offset tree miles right of track, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL360，向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a Distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在驾驶舱有烟雾，向 Rhein Radar 发出遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降以排除烟雾。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Rhein Radar, SIA 308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Rhein Radar，SIA 308，驾驶舱有烟雾，请求紧急下降以排烟。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 308, roger MAYDAY, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: read back the instructions and tell the controller you are working the checklist and will advise.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 308，收到 MAYDAY，下降至并保持 FL100，随时通报机上情况和你的意图。
B：复诵指令，并告诉管制员你正在执行检查单，稍后报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain FL110, we are working the checklist, will advise, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 FL110，我们正在执行检查单，稍后报告，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, the smoke can't be removed and you decide to divert to Paris, inform the controller your situation and intention.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，烟雾无法消除，你决定备降巴黎，通知管制员你的情况和意图。
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA 308, the smoke can't be removed, request divert to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: Rhein Radar，SIA 308，烟雾无法消除，请求备降巴黎。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, roger, turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, contact Paris Approach on 119.4.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，收到，左转航向 350，下降至并保持 8000 英尺，联系巴黎进近 119.4。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, 119.4, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 350，下降至并保持 8000 英尺，119.4，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，下降至并保持 6000 英尺，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 08L。
cards.referenceText: descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 08L, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 6000 英尺，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 08L，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: Now you have landed on Runway 08L, but you missed the first rapid exit, report it to Paris Tower and request vacate via the second rapid exit.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已在 Runway 08L 落地，但错过了第一个快速脱离道，向巴黎塔台报告并请求经第二个快速脱离道脱离。
cards.referenceText: Paris Tower, SIA 308, we have missed the first rapid exit, request vacate via second rapid exit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎塔台，SIA 308，我们错过了第一个快速脱离道，请求经第二个快速脱离道脱离。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, roger, take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，收到，使用第二个快速脱离道，脱离后联系巴黎地面 118.5。
cards.referenceText: Take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 使用第二个快速脱离道，脱离后联系巴黎地面 118.5，SIA 308。
